title: Aureline M5 sidecar-completeness manifest
description: Canonical per-domain sidecar-completeness manifest for the release and emergency-hotfix build lanes. Names the resolved exact build identity, the claimed artifact families, the sidecar-family ledger, the binding-identity check, the missing-or-mismatched reference, the attestation state, and the last convergence revision, and tracks whether every claimed sidecar (binaries, packages, docs packs, schemas, SBOMs, symbols, source maps, and rollback metadata) converged on one build identity, was reconciled against the materialized-input receipt, or came from a hermetic rebuild, so a green build can never omit a claimed sidecar family, a sidecar is never bound to a different build identity, and a missing or mismatched sidecar is a shiproom blocker rather than a warning-only state. Downstream release-center, shiproom, diagnostics, provenance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's sidecar completeness by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
